tickets.subject: VPN connection drops intermittently
tickets.description: User reports the corporate VPN tunnel disconnects every few minutes when on the engineering subnet.
tickets.aiSummary: Customer experiences recurring VPN disconnects on the engineering subnet; likely MTU or IKE rekey timing.
aiInsights: Disconnects align with IKE rekey interval.
Started after the latest firewall firmware update.
tickets.aiRootCause: Aggressive IKE rekey timer after firewall firmware upgrade.

tickets.subject: Email not syncing on mobile
tickets.description: Outlook mobile stopped syncing after the user changed their password.
tickets.aiSummary: Mobile mail sync broke following a password change; app retains a stale OAuth token.
aiInsights: Stale OAuth refresh token on device.
tickets.aiRootCause: Cached OAuth token not invalidated on password rotation.

tickets.subject: Password reset not working
tickets.description: Self-service password reset emails are not arriving for several users.
tickets.aiSummary: Multiple users cannot complete password resets; reset emails appear to be blocked upstream.
aiInsights: Affects multiple users in one tenant.
Reset emails not in spam either.
tickets.aiRootCause: Outbound reset mail rejected due to DKIM signature mismatch.

tickets.subject: Cannot access shared drive
tickets.description: Finance department lost access to the shared drive after an AD group change.
tickets.aiSummary: Resolved: finance security group membership was restored and access verified.
aiInsights: AD group nesting was removed by mistake.
tickets.aiRootCause: Accidental removal of nested AD security group.

tickets.subject: Software installation fails with error 0x80070643
tickets.description: Endpoint agent install fails on Windows 11 workstations.
tickets.aiSummary: MSI install fails with 0x80070643, typically a pending reboot or .NET runtime issue.
aiInsights: Error 0x80070643 indicates a failed MSI rollback.
tickets.aiRootCause: Pending OS reboot preventing MSI completion.

tickets.subject: Quarterly access review request
tickets.description: Compliance requests an export of privileged account access for the quarter.
tickets.aiSummary: Closed: privileged access export delivered to compliance and acknowledged.
